# gdpr-compliance-ai-mcp

> MCP server for gdpr compliance ai. Features classify processing, lawful basis assessment, dpia generator. From MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- classify_processing
- lawful_basis_assessment
- dpia_generator
- rights_request_handler
- breach_notification
- crosswalk_to_eu_ai_act

## Install
```
pip install gdpr-compliance-ai-mcp
```

## Links
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/gdpr-compliance-ai-mcp/
- Docs: https://meok.ai
